name: Davao Medical School Foundation
tagline: Real hospital exposure that makes you a doctor. One of the most respected medical institutions in the Philippines, built on clinical excellence.

why.title: Exceptional Clinical Training
why.text: High-volume hospital exposure from the early years, building real diagnostic and clinical skills through genuine patient care.

why.title: Internationally Recognised Degree
why.text: Curriculum aligned to NMC guidelines, and listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools. Listing is not in itself recognition, accreditation or endorsement.

why.title: Strong FMGE and PLE Pass Rates
why.text: A proven track record of Indian students clearing the FMGE, supported by free LIMRA coaching worth ₹1 lakh.

why.title: Modern Campus in Davao City
why.text: Advanced medical facilities and a vibrant international student community in one of the safest cities in the Philippines.

why.title: Diverse International Community
why.text: Study alongside students from across Asia and the world in a multicultural environment that builds global perspective.

clinical.intro: DMSF students train across five affiliated hospitals with a combined 4,500+ beds, gaining early patient interaction and advanced medical-technology training from the first years.

name: Gullas College of Medicine
adTitle: Study MBBS at Gullas College of Medicine, Cebu
tagline: Affordable fees, global standards, life-changing learning. Set in the heart of Cebu, one of the most vibrant cities in the Philippines.

why.title: Zero Donation or Capitation Fees
why.text: What you see is what you pay. Transparent, honest pricing with no hidden charges at any stage of the programme.

why.title: Strong FMGE and PLE Results
why.text: A consistent track record of Indian students clearing the FMGE. With free LIMRA coaching, your chances are stronger still.

why.title: Internationally Recognised Degree
why.text: Curriculum aligned to NMC guidelines, and listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools. Listing is not in itself recognition, accreditation or endorsement.

why.title: Extensive Clinical Training
why.text: Hospital rotations in government and private facilities across Cebu give you diverse, high-volume exposure that builds real clinical confidence.

why.title: Cebu City, Vibrant and Safe
why.text: One of the most developed cities in the Philippines, with excellent infrastructure, international connectivity, and a large Indian student community.

clinical.intro: GCM offers strong clinical exposure through eight reputed hospitals across Cebu, with hands-on training and real-time patient care that build skills and confidence for a medical career.

name: Brokenshire College of Medicine
adTitle: Study MBBS at Brokenshire College, Philippines
tagline: A compassion-centred medical education with its own teaching hospital, shaping doctors who are clinically skilled and deeply human.

why.title: Its Own Teaching Hospital
why.text: Brokenshire runs a fully equipped hospital of its own, giving students seamless, consistent clinical training under direct faculty supervision.

why.title: NMC Aligned Curriculum
why.text: Every course and clinical module is structured in line with National Medical Commission requirements for Indian students.

why.title: Experienced, Dedicated Faculty
why.text: Professors who are practising clinicians, bringing real-world medical insight into the classroom and the wards every day.

why.title: Supportive International Environment
why.text: A welcoming campus community in Davao that is safe, diverse, and structured to help international students settle in quickly.

why.title: Affordable Fees, No Hidden Costs
why.text: A transparent pricing structure with no donation fees and no surprise charges. Quality medical education designed to remain financially manageable for families.

clinical.intro: Brokenshire students train across five accredited hospitals with a combined 4,500+ beds, backed by a clinical heritage going back to 1954.

name: Universidade Católica Timorense
tagline: A unique international medical education in the heart of Southeast Asia. Affordable, personalised, and fully supported by LIMRA from day one.

why.title: Small Class Sizes, More Attention
why.text: Smaller student batches mean personalised academic support, closer faculty relationships, and a learning environment where nobody falls behind.

why.title: Truly Affordable Medical Education
why.text: Significantly lower tuition and living costs than colleges in the Philippines, making MBBS accessible without compromising on quality.

why.title: Unique International Learning Experience
why.text: Study in the youngest nation in Southeast Asia, in a multicultural environment that builds global perspective and cross-cultural medical competence.

why.title: Clinical Training in Real Hospitals
why.text: Hospital rotations at the national hospital of Timor-Leste and affiliated regional centres give you practical, patient-centred exposure from the early years.

why.title: Full LIMRA Support Throughout
why.text: From admission and visa through to graduation and FMGE prep, 24 years of LIMRA experience means expert guidance at every stage.

clinical.intro: Real-time clinical exposure through hospital partnerships, with early patient interaction, simulation-based skills training, and supportive Indian faculty throughout.

name: University of PEACE
adTitle: Study MBBS at University of PEACE, Timor-Leste
tagline: Building doctors for a peaceful tomorrow. Affordable, quality medical education in Timor-Leste with full LIMRA support from day one to FMGE success.

why.title: Genuinely Affordable Education
why.text: Lower tuition and living costs than the Philippines, making quality medical education accessible for more Indian families.

why.title: Internationally Oriented MD Program
why.text: A medical degree aligned to international standards, preparing students to clear the FMGE and practise medicine in India and globally.

why.title: Practical Clinical Training
why.text: Hospital rotations in the major healthcare facilities of Dili give hands-on experience that builds clinical thinking from the early years.

why.title: Multicultural Learning Environment
why.text: Study alongside students from across Asia on a campus that celebrates diversity and builds cross-cultural medical competence.

why.title: Full LIMRA Support, Start to Finish
why.text: Admission, visa, travel, settlement, and FMGE prep. A 24-year track record means no student navigates this journey alone.

clinical.intro: A 12-month rotational internship at the affiliated Guido Valadares National Hospital, with hands-on rotations across emergency, critical care, wards, theatres and rural health.
